name: Potens
summary: Potens Semiconductor Corp. specializes in the design, development, and global sale of power discrete devices. Operating across Taiwan, Asia, Europe, and other international markets, the company offers a diverse portfolio of components, including low and medium voltage MOSFETs, power IGBTs, and cutting-edge power semiconductor products utilizing GaN and SiC technologies. These solutions cater to various industries such as consumer electronics, telecommunications, industrial applications, and the automotive sector. Specific applications include critical areas like 5G infrastructure, fully automated vehicles, wireless power transmission systems, and cloud data centers. Established in 2012, Potens Semiconductor Corp. maintains its headquarters in Zhubei, Taiwan.
